description.en: Open the Explorer at Testudines to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开龟鳖类，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Open the 205.7–201.4 Ma Rhaetian window to inspect holotype NHMUK PV R36822 from the Cromhall fissure-fill sample alongside competing published placements: the original crown-squamate interpretation and later anatomical and matrix reanalyses.
description.zh: 打开 205.7–201.4 Ma 的瑞替阶窗口，在 Cromhall 裂隙充填样本的正模标本 NHMUK PV R36822 旁检查相互竞争的已发表定位：最初的冠群有鳞类解释，以及后续的解剖和矩阵重分析。

limitations: The Rhaetian route is a rounded fissure-fill study window, not a direct date for NHMUK PV R36822; fissure age and referred-element identity remain bounded by the cited studies.

Whiteside et al. recover a crown-squamate placement, while Brownstein et al. and Caldwell et al. publish conflicting anatomical scorings and placements; the package preserves this as contested topology, not a secure crown-Squamata FAD or direct ancestor.

The CAO2024 map frame supplies age context while markers remain bounded occurrence samples; this scene does not establish complete distribution, global FAD/LAD, observed behaviour or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.zh: Megachirella 泛有鳞类干群窗口

description.en: Open the approximately 240 Ma Middle Triassic window around Megachirella wachtleri holotype PZO 628 from the Italian Alps to inspect CT anatomy and its combined-evidence stem-squamate placement on the broader Pan-Squamata route.
description.zh: 打开约 240 Ma 的中三叠世窗口，在意大利阿尔卑斯 Megachirella wachtleri 正模标本 PZO 628 周围检查 CT 解剖，以及其在更广义泛有鳞类路线上的综合证据干群有鳞类定位。

limitations: PZO 628 is a single named Middle Triassic specimen; the rounded 240 Ma selector is a study-level horizon anchor, not a direct date for every element or a global Pan-Squamata FAD.
The combined morphology–molecular placement is an analysis result and does not identify Megachirella as a direct ancestor or convert a stem sample into a crown-Squamata origin date.

The CAO2024 map frame supplies age context while markers remain bounded occurrence samples; this scene does not establish complete distribution, observed behaviour or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.zh: 喙头蜥类时标形态差异窗口

description.en: Open the rounded 238 Ma–present study-sample window to inspect the fossil rhynchocephalian record beside living Sphenodon punctatus and the Herrera-Flores–Stubbs–Benton quantitative disparity and lineage-rate results.
description.zh: 打开约 238 Ma 至现生的研究样本窗口，在现生 Sphenodon punctatus 旁检查化石喙头蜥类记录，以及 Herrera-Flores–Stubbs–Benton 的定量形态差异与谱系速率结果。

limitations: The 238 Ma–present route is a rounded time-scaled sample envelope from Herrera-Flores et al., not a complete global Rhynchocephalia range or an exact fossil FAD/LAD.

Fossil diversity, morphospace occupancy and lineage-rate estimates are observations and models for the compiled sample; Sphenodon is a surviving lineage, not an unchanged ancestor or proxy for every fossil member.

The CAO2024 map frame supplies age context while markers remain bounded occurrence samples; this scene does not establish complete distribution, direct ancestry, observed behaviour or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.zh: 蛇类末端定年模型窗口

description.en: Open the 117.1–104 Ma posterior window around the approximately 110.3 Ma crown-snake estimate to inspect the Hsiang et al. combined genomic, phenomic and fossil analysis, which sampled named stem snakes including Najash, Dinilysia and Coniophis.
description.zh: 打开约 110.3 Ma 冠群蛇估计的 117.1–104 Ma 后验窗口，检查 Hsiang 等人结合基因组、表型组与化石的分析；该分析采样了 Najash、Dinilysia 和 Coniophis 等具名干群蛇类。

limitations: The 110.3 Ma crown estimate and 117.1–104 Ma interval are tip-dating model outputs; the available 128.5 Ma–present route also retains the separate Pan-Serpentes estimate and is not a fossil occurrence or global crown FAD/LAD.

Ancestral ecology, habitat and biogeographic reconstructions depend on topology, taxon sampling, priors and model choice; named fossil snakes constrain the analysis but are not direct ancestors of living snakes.

The CAO2024 map frame supplies age context while markers remain bounded occurrence samples; this scene does not establish complete distribution, observed behaviour or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.zh: 龟鳖与鳞龙多样性样本

description.en: Open a source-bounded Turtles and lepidosaurs interval in the diversity view to inspect bundled sample counts, not an estimate of total richness.
description.zh: 在多样性视图中打开有来源边界的龟鳖与鳞龙区间，检查包内样本计数，而不是总体丰富度估计。

limitations: Counts are derived from the bundled, bounded occurrence sample and do not estimate total diversity, preservation-corrected richness, or a complete taxon range.
